other_conditions: The enterprise must possess a Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per the MSME Development Act 2006.
Application for reimbursement must be made within 12 months of obtaining the quality certification(s).
The enterprise must be in commercial production at the time of disbursement and cannot be a closed unit.
Each MSME can apply only once under the scheme.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 50% of quality certification costs, capped at ₹3,00,000 per enterprise.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of mandatory documents (if required)
